Flag images for the chart's economic-event markers (28 Oct 2026): Twemoji 15.1.0 (jdecked/twemoji), the same emoji set the app's
chat uses, by Twitter, Inc and other contributors, licensed CC-BY 4.0 (LICENSE-GRAPHICS.txt). Only change: width and height added to
the svg element so the browser draws them sharp. Named by the emoji's code points: 1f1fa-1f1f8 = US, 1f1ea-1f1fa = EU, 1f1ec-1f1e7 = GB,
1f1ef-1f1f5 = JP, 1f1e8-1f1ed = CH, 1f1e6-1f1fa = AU, 1f1e8-1f1e6 = CA, 1f1f3-1f1ff = NZ, 1f1e8-1f1f3 = CN.
